ruleRegistry.title: Each source package balances (debits = credits)
Every source line maps to the group chart in the active mapping version
Intercompany pairs agree within materiality before elimination
Every functional currency has closing and average rates in the active rate set
Full consolidation only with a recorded control conclusion; effective interest at most 100%
Every consolidation journal balances
Unrealised margin = goods held at transfer price × IC margin ÷ IC sales (seller-tagged)
NCI share of profit = NCI % × (subsidiary profit − upstream unrealised margin)
Acquisition-date fair values equal book values (no fair-value adjustment recorded)
Consolidated trial balance nets to zero (assets = liabilities + equity)
Cash-flow closing cash equals balance-sheet cash with no balancing line
Deferred tax on unrealised margin = unrealised × buyer's tax rate (tagged to the seller for NCI)
No cross-currency monetary intercompany pair until monetary IC FX is implemented
Consolidation goodwill is never touched by a bridge or adjustment (entity goodwill is GOODWILL_LOCAL)
No duplicate keys in journals, journal lines or adjustments
Every foreign operation has its historic (acquisition-date) rate
A foreign operation with opening balances has an opening rate (no fallback to closing)
Opening equity of a foreign operation translated at a single historic rate (simplified opening translation) — accept with disclosure
Opening translated equity equals the prior signed-off close's closing translated equity
Goodwill = consideration − parent share of fair-value net assets at acquisition
Bargain purchase: identification and measurement reassessed (acceptance cites the reassessment memo)
Share of associate profit = holding % × the associate's reported profit
Effective interest = holder's effective interest × direct interest (chains)
Change in ownership without loss of control: NCI moves by its proportionate share; difference to parent equity
Effect of exchange rates on cash equals the remeasurement of cash balances to the closing rate
Every fair-value uplift has a subsequent-measurement basis
An FV_REMEASURED uplift overlapping an IFRS 9 bridge on the same asset cites the offset
The cash-flow FX line is computed from cash accounts only (per-entity cash roll-forward)
Each bridge's opening input equals the prior signed-off close's closing bridge balance (or a documented change)
Insurance-contract remeasurement cites ACT-RUN-<YYYY-MM>-<ENTITY>-<id> for the close period with OUTPUT_SHA256 and SIGNED_BY
IFRS 17 components equal the actuarial control total exactly (no balancing line)
RfB reversal and IFRS 17 remeasurement on one entity cite an offset reference (no double count)
